profile.headline: Software Engineer at InterSystems
profile.summary: I'm an MIT grad with a major in computer science and math, and I'm interesting in applying computation and quantitative techniques to all sorts of technical problems. In my last project I worked on how to build powerful speech-to-text technology to provide fast and accurate text conversions. Now I'm open to experience work in all aspects of software development!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: JavaScript · AngularJS · Angular · Web Engineering

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I worked on creating sleek customer UI for Rev's online editors, and helped implement a front to back legal deposition transcription service to serve customers desiring speech-to-text transcription in the legal sphere.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: I was responsible for leading recitations, writing recitation outlines and problem sets, grading exams, and also managed online platforms for the class such as Gradescope, Canvas, Piazza, and Zoom.

positions.title: Curriculum Development Intern
positions.description: Authored lessons for and worked on course redesigns for online and in-person lessons. Wrote problems and developed activities to help students engage with mathematical content. Created interactive self-paced lessons and minigames for students of all ages.

positions.title: Grader and Releaser
positions.description: Graded student work for online homework submissions, and also revised graded feedback to be released to the students.

positions.title: Junior Counselor
positions.description: Graded student work on abstract algebraic problem sets, gave feedback and oversaw student progress. Also took advanced courses in number theory and analysis.

honors.title: Emerson Fellow in Jazz
honors.description: Was chosen as one of 3 undergraduate students for distinguished musical ability in jazz to receive a full year of private lessons and to participate in a weekly performance workshop to improve my musical skills.
honors.issuer: Issued by Massachusetts Institute of Technology · Sep 2021

honors.title: USA(J)MO Qualifier (2013-2018)
honors.description: 2013 USA Junior Math Olympiad qualifier, 2014-2018 USA Math Olympiad qualifier
